1 bird · butterfly · fly · kangaroo — kangaroos can't fly!
2 crocodile · snake · tiger · elephant — snakes haven't got legs!
3 monkey · fish · frog · whale — the other three live in/near water!
4 giraffe · lion · spider · tiger — spiders have got eight legs!

Grammar · Ex 5 · SB p. 91

Make them negative! 🚫

🎯 Read the text — write the sentences in your notebook!

Jason and his family are very different! Jason wants an iguana. His sister, Jackie, wants a rabbit and their parents want a parrot! They all watch TV. Jackie and their parents like films and Jason likes cartoons! At the weekends Jason goes to the park with his friends, Jackie hangs out with her best friend and their parents visit the neighbours.

they → don't · he / she / it → doesn't
1 · Jackie and Jason don't want a parrot. ✏️
2 · Their parents don't want an iguana.
3 · Jackie doesn't like cartoons.
4 · Jason doesn't go to the park with his parents.
5 · Their parents don't go to the park.
Grammar · Ex 6 · SB p. 91

Ask the questions! ❓

🎯 Write the questions in your notebook — tap and check!
1Jason / want / a rabbit → Does Jason want a rabbit? — No, he doesn't. ✏️
2their parents / want / an iguana? — Do their parents want an iguana? No, they don't.
3they all / watch TV? — Do they all watch TV? Yes, they do.
4What / Jackie / do / at the weekend? — What does Jackie do at the weekend? She hangs out with her best friend.
5Where / Jason / go / at the weekend? — Where does Jason go at the weekend? He goes to the park with his friends.
Communication · Ex 7 · SB p. 91

Choose the answer! 🎫

🎯 Class vote — a or b? Then tap and check!
1«Can I help you?» — a Can I have a ticket, please? · b Would you like a ticket? → a!
2«That's ten pounds ninety.» — a The money's here. · b Here you are. → b!
3«Here are your tickets.» — a Thanks. · b No, they aren't. → a!

🔤 New words: unusual · exotic — from another country, not ordinary!

Ex 2 · SB p. 92 · 🎧 3.35

Three unusual pets — read and match! 🔎

🎯 Listen and read — match texts 1–3 to the photos in your book!
1Tarantulas — Spiders are scary but some people think tarantulas are pretty. They are quiet animals and they don't need a lot of space or food, so they aren't hard work.
2Pygmy hedgehogs — People like pygmy hedgehogs because they are small and cute. They eat cat food and they eat a lot! This is why they need a lot of space to run and play.
3Axolotls — They've got a funny name and they look funny too. They live in the water. They can be brown, black, yellow, white or other colours. And here's an amazing fact: if they lose a part of their body, they can make a new one!
🤔 One photo has NO text — which one? Photo C — the snail! 🐌
Ex 3 · SB p. 92

Which pet is it? 🐾

🎯 Answer — then stand up and check with three friends!
1Which pet eats a lot? → the pygmy hedgehog! ✏️
2Which pet can make new body parts? → the axolotls!
3Which pet needs a lot of space? → the pygmy hedgehog!
4Which pet doesn't need a lot of food? → the tarantula!
5Which pet can be different colours? → the axolotls!
6Which pet can be scary? → the tarantula!

Homework

At home! 🏠

📘 THE RULE — copy it into your notebook and learn it!

it · he · she — and ONE thing (a singular noun) → the verb takes -S

Jason likes cartoons. · Jackie hangs out with her best friend. · He goes to the park.

✏️ SB p. 91 ex. 6 — write the questions and short answers in your notebook

📒 Copy the words into your dictionary! The word + one: Russian · meaning · example. Write first — then tap and check! ✓

1different → разные · not the same · Jason and his family are very different!
2want → хотеть · to wish for something · Jackie wants a rabbit.
3their → их · of them · Their parents want a parrot.
4cartoons → мультфильмы · funny animated films · Jason likes cartoons!
5neighbours → соседи · the people next door · Their parents visit the neighbours.
6at the weekend → на выходных · on Saturday and Sunday · What do you do at the weekend?
7hang out with their friends → проводить время с друзьями · to spend time with friends · They hang out with their friends at the weekend.
